# OmniTune v0.12.9

## Fixes
- Restored fullscreen player inline lyrics under the song title by requesting missing synced lyrics when the player screen is opened.
- Fixed synced lyrics auto-scroll so it waits for the lyrics list layout before jumping to the active line.
- Updated the main app launcher icon with the new OmniTune app artwork.
- Updated the notification/status icon and home top-left OmniTune mark with the provided notification artwork.
- Updated notification fallback artwork to use the OmniTune notification logo instead of the launcher icon.
